{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

df = df[df['channel'].isin(['email', 'paid_search'])]

df = df[df['customer_segment'].isin(['new', 'returning', 'loyal'])]

df_grouped = df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].agg(['mean', 'count']).reset_index()
df_grouped = df_grouped.rename(columns={'mean': 'conversion_rate'})

df_channel_total = df_grouped.groupby('channel')[['conversion_rate', 'count']].sum().reset_index()
df_channel_total['weighted_conversion_rate'] = df_channel_total['conversion_rate'] * df_channel_total['count']

total_count = df_channel_total['count'].sum()
df_channel_total['weighted_conversion_rate'] = df_channel_total['weighted_conversion_rate'] / total_count

e_email = df_channel_total[df_channel_total['channel'] == 'email']['weighted_conversion_rate'].values[0]
e_paid_search = df_channel_total[df_channel_total['channel'] == 'paid_search']['weighted_conversion_rate'].values[0]
diff = e_email - e_paid_search

# Print the required values
print(f'Weighted conversion rate for email: {e_email}')
print(f'Weighted conversion rate for paid_search: {e_paid_search}')
print(f'Difference (email minus paid_search): {diff}')"}
